2026.title: Frontend developer
2026.shortDescription: Fully autonomous design and development of the online subscription (self-care) journey for the CAWL (Crédit Agricole Worldline) professional payment offer. Front-end expert role (Angular / NodeJS) within the cross-functional chapter (Spotify model) for the payment commercial squad.
2026.description: Full development of the digital self-care subscription journey (a 100% autonomous process allowing professional clients to configure and finalize their online payment offer up to electronic contract signature). The CAWL project (similar to SumUp) covers equipment selection (mobile card readers, hardware card readers, or remote payment), configuration of accepted payment methods (American Express, etc.), and handling of business-specific requirements. As referent and expert of the cross-functional front-end chapter, close pairing with UX/UI designers in Figma is required to translate the mockups. Front-end architecture built on the latest version of Angular, backed by a BFF (Backend For Frontend) layer in NodeJS developed with GitHub Copilot assistance. Used the internal MUESLI design system. Worked autonomously on the front-end within a dedicated Squad (1 developer, 2 Business Analysts, 1 Product Owner) under Agile methodology with Jira, Confluence and Microsoft Teams.

2025_2026.title: Full-stack developer
2025_2026.shortDescription: Development and evolution of the core business tool for tracking advisors' sales activity. Worked under the Agile Spotify methodology within a squad. Development organized by Application Unit (AU) with a native front-end and a Java Spring Boot back-end.
2025_2026.description: Designed and maintained the strategic tool for managing review reports, insurance recommendations, and commercial activity reports. Delivered back-end development in Java / Spring Boot and front-end development (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript / TypeScript with Webpack), including the internal Angular component library MUESLI integrated from Figma mockups. Worked within the "Commercial Activity" Squad (4 developers, 2 Business Analysts, 1 Product Owner) in the "Employee Distribution" Tribe, under the Agile Spotify model. Formed part of an autonomous "Application Unit" covering the entire front-end and back-end scope. Monthly delivery cadence driven by Agile ceremonies in Jira, actively facilitated via Klaxoon and Microsoft Teams. Tracked code quality with SonarQube, managed artifacts with JFrog / Artifactory / Nexus, containerized with Docker, packaged applications with Helm, and ran continuous GitOps deployment via Argo CD with GitLab CI / Jenkins. Collaborated with infrastructure teams (CAGIP) for multi-environment deliveries.

2023_2025.title: Backend developer
2023_2025.shortDescription: Corrective and evolutive maintenance of a financial securities management platform run under a V-model cycle. High-complexity project with strong business constraints. Existing J2EE/JSP front-end alongside a parallel graphic redesign project in Angular, with a Java Spring Boot back-end.
2023_2025.description: Handled evolutions and corrections on the asset management platform (equities, mutual funds/OPC) for professional and retail clients. Application ecosystem combining modern components (Angular 18, HTML / CSS, Java 21 / Spring Boot with Maven), alongside legacy modules (J2EE, JSP). Tracked and prepared production releases across Development, Pre-production and Production environments. UAT testing in Squash TM with a dedicated test team. Worked within a rigorous V-model cycle.

2021_2023.title: Full-stack developer
2021_2023.shortDescription: Full redesign and evolution of the critical tool used to report and broadcast passenger incidents. First project with a classic front-end / back-end structure (AngularJS / Java Spring Boot), with major ergonomic issues and visual redesign work.
2021_2023.description: Major involvement in the central incident reporting tool (RATP/SNCF) for real-time broadcast on displays (yellow boards) and digital media. Split and integrated interfaces in AngularJS, graphic redesign aligned with the SNCF Connect brand guidelines from Figma mockups. Optimized ergonomics for users under stress (advanced autocomplete, smart input, moving from a multi-step wizard to a one-page form). Feasibility study for the migration to Angular 14. Managed deliveries across Development, Pre-production and Production environments. Supported the dedicated Ops team through the Move to Cloud transition to Microsoft Azure. Agile organization (Scrum) with Jira, Confluence and Microsoft Teams, quality assurance via Squash TM (working with a dedicated validation team) and a CI/CD chain (Jenkins, GitLab, Nexus, SonarQube).

2018_2021.title: Big Data Developer
2018_2021.shortDescription: Corrective and evolutive maintenance of a centralized monitoring solution (ELK stack, Datadog, Grafana) for Transilien network equipment. Delivered targeted AngularJS developments (Kibana source code), Grok-based Logstash parsing, an autonomous AI module, and multi-environment deployment tracking.
2018_2021.description: Monitored all equipment and application components deployed at stations and on board trains. Collected logs and administered their parsing. Deployed the ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), wrote Grok log-parsing filters, built native and custom dashboards in Kibana, and integrated Datadog metrics. Developed dedicated AngularJS plugins, tested with Karma and Jasmine. Managed versioning and code branches with GitKraken. Built a .NET Core back-end component to process complex algorithms and query APIs (Google Analytics). Independently designed a Proof of Concept (POC) in Python / TensorFlow to automate visual recognition of station and train displays in order to detect anomalies. Tracked deployments across Development, Pre-production and Production environments. Project run in an Agile framework (Kanban/Scrum) with Jira and Confluence, supported by Microsoft Teams for daily communication, a CI/CD chain (Jenkins, GitLab) and quality control (SonarQube).

2018.title: Web Developer
2018.shortDescription: Contributed to the development of an internal tournament management application within the innovation department. Learned application scaffolding with JHipster, Java unit testing, and collaborative development best practices with Git.
2018.description: Learned and used the JHipster framework (Java / Spring Boot) to structure and speed up the creation of an internal tournament application. Wrote unit tests with JUnit and Mockito to prevent regressions. Joined a technical team (one Tech Lead and two senior developers) to get introduced to enterprise working methods. Team communication via Microsoft Teams and Outlook. Daily introduction and application of version control and code collaboration best practices with Git.

2022.title: SCRUM Master Certification
2022.description: PSM I - Professional Scrum Master 1 Scrum.org.
2022.longDescription: Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I) certification delivered by Scrum.org, validating a solid understanding of Scrum framework fundamentals: roles, events, and artifacts, as well as the underlying Agile values and principles. This certification reinforced my ability to facilitate Scrum ceremonies, remove blockers for the development team, and support product owners in maximizing delivered value.

2019_2021.title: Master's Degree at EPSI School
2019_2021.description: RNCP Level 7 Certification - Expert in IT and Information Systems. Work-study program at Capgemini (3 weeks / 1 week). Project management, software engineering, Big Data & AI specialization, thesis on technical monitoring.
2019_2021.longDescription: RNCP Level 7 certified Master's degree (Expert in IT and Information Systems) completed via a work-study program at Capgemini (3 weeks in the company, 1 week at school). The curriculum combined project management, software engineering, and a Big Data & AI specialization, culminating in a thesis on technical monitoring. This program was my first deep dive into large-scale enterprise software delivery, agile project governance, and applied data engineering practices.

2018_2019.title: Professional Bachelor's Degree MIAR
2018_2019.description: Work-study program at Capgemini (3 weeks / 1 week). Object-oriented programming, Mobile development, Client/Server Web, Development tools, Distributed programming...
2018_2019.longDescription: Professional Bachelor's degree in MIAR (Web and Mobile Applications and Networks Engineering), completed via a work-study program at Capgemini (3 weeks in the company, 1 week at school). Coursework covered object-oriented programming, mobile development, client/server web architectures, development tooling, and distributed programming, building the technical foundation for full-stack development.

2016_2018.title: DUT in Computer Science
2016_2018.description: IT modules (web development, databases, networks). General education (English, law, accounting, project management).
2016_2018.longDescription: University Diploma in Computer Science (DUT), combining core IT modules — web development, databases, and networking — with a general education in English, law, accounting, and project management. This two-year program built the broad technical and professional foundation on which the rest of my career has been built.
